plan_form.what_i_would_have_wanted_and_the_library: 1. C3: no instrument checks each case's category against the requester's rule. 2. C5: the account reads can only be checked with scope of a call, at 10 per line from an allowance of 50. That covers at most 5 of the 101 reads, so I will spend it on reads the record marks as odd (row counts, items or customers that don't fit). 3. C10: the outbox can only be checked with trace of a call, also 10 per line. A preview call looks the same in the record as a real send, so a confirmed send does not prove a row reached the outbox. Checking all 100 sends from the outbox would need a set-wide outbox check, and the library has none. 4. The live tables: same set and summary of the change read only the staged set as it was kept, so nothing checks the live tables directly after the promotion. Only the promotion's line in the record, with the state it found and the state it left, links the live tables to the staged set.
